 CZ 457 SERIES A NEW GENERATION OF MODERN RIMFIRE RIFLES 

 The CZ 457 series offers exceptional user comfort due to its easy, fast and reliable operation, even with a mounted riflescope. For maximum safety, it comes with a push-to-fire safety on the right side of the receiver, striker status indicator and a separate bolt extractor control. Shooting accuracy is ensured with its adjustable trigger mechanism that features low trigger pull weight and excellent travel, combined with a noticeably lighter striker and a new type of bedding. Other benefits include an extremely durable anticorrosion finish on metal parts, easy change of caliber by users and reliable polymer magazines that are compatible with the previous generation of CZ rimfire rifles.

 The American 457 is the perfect example of a classic sport and hunting gun. The varnished American-style stock is made from high quality walnut, with checkering on the grip that incorporates a fleur-de-lis motif. The light profile, cold hammer forged barrel is 630 mm long and has no sights.

name: CZ 515 Tac 22WMR/LR F00000338
description:
CZ 515 Tac 22WMR/LR F00000338

 Overview

 The CZ 515 is an Australian exclusive bolt action lever release rimfire rifle designed for hunters and target shooters.

 The rifle is fitted with an automatic bolt stop in the rear position and an ergonomically designed lever for releasing the bolt. The lever release is ergonomically designed and can be transferred to the left hand side of the firearm to accommodate left handed shooters

This version is a modern Tactical model with pistol grip, adjustable stock (length and cheek piece), picatinny rail, full length barrel shroud and supplied with a 10 round polymer magazine.

Available in this 22LR as well as 22WMR .

The CZ 515 is also available in a stylish Hunter model with an American style beechwood stock and supplied with a 10 round polymer magazine.

Available in 22LR and 22WMR .

description:

 The 100% American-made Ruger American Rimfire bolt-action rifle builds on the enormous success of the centerfire Ruger American Rifle. With many of the standard Ruger American Rifle features, this new line also combines several design innovations from the popular 10/22 rimfire rifle. This combination, along with the rifle's adaptability, appeals to bolt-action enthusiasts - whether young or old, novice or experienced.

Standard models come with long length of pull modules, while compact models come with short length of pull modules.  - Uses the detachable, flush-mounted 10/22 style BX-1 10-round rotary magazine.

name: Walther PPQ M2 22LR NFID F00017603
description:
Walther PPQ M2 22LR NFID F00017603

 Description

 The Walther PPQ M2 .22 LR semi-auto pistol is the best of both worlds. By combining the smooth-shooting, ergonomically advanced components of the PPQ with the fun and cost-saving benefits of the .22 rimfire, you have the pleasure of shooting shot after shot both accurately and affordably.

 The M2 comes with an ambidextrous slide stop lever, high-strength polymer frame, as well as front and rear slide serrations. It has a left-side magazine release, reversible to the right, plus a MIL-STD 1913 Picatinny rail, red fibre optic front sight and adjustable rear sight. Very short trigger travel and reset path, with a trigger pull of 2200g.
